preco-de-venda.descricao_pagina: Work out the selling price from your cost, with margin on the sale, card fee and tax. The calculation runs in your browser.
preco-de-venda.resumo: Enter your cost and where the money goes. The tool gives you the break-even price, the price with the margin you want and how much you keep.

grupos.saidas: What comes out of the price

campos.despesa_ajuda: Divide your monthly fixed cost by the quantity you usually sell.
campos.margem: Margin you want on the sale
campos.margem_ajuda: Margin on the sale, not a markup on the cost — the maths is different.

resultado.nota_plus: Exporting the spreadsheet with every scenario is a Plus feature. The calculation, the copy and the PDF stay free.
resultado.resumo_copia: Suggested price {preco} · total cost {custo} · fee and tax {taxa} · left {sobra} · break-even price {minimo}

conta.nota: A zero or negative denominator is refused: with those percentages no price is possible.

erros.custo_zerado: Enter the product cost to calculate.
erros.margem_acima_do_limite: Margin + fee + tax go over 100%. No price can close that equation — bring the margin below {limite}.

plus.titulo: The scenario spreadsheet is a Plus feature
plus.texto: Plus exports the table with the price for each margin, from 10% to 50%. The calculation and the PDF stay free.

como_usar.um: Add up everything you pay to get the product ready — raw material, packaging, inbound shipping. That is the **cost**.
como_usar.dois: Divide your monthly fixed cost by the quantity you usually sell and enter the value per unit.
como_usar.tres: Enter the card fee and the tax as a percentage **of the final price**, which is how they are charged.
como_usar.quatro: Adjust the margin and watch what is left per sale. If it goes negative, the price does not cover the cost.

margem_markup.pergunta: Is a 30% margin the same as a 30% markup?
margem_markup.resposta: No. A 30% margin means R$ 30 out of every R$ 100 sold stays with you. A 30% markup adds 30% to the cost — and gives a lower price. This tool works with margin on the sale.

minimo.pergunta: Why is the break-even price not just cost + fee?
minimo.resposta: Because the fee and the tax fall on the price, not on the cost. Adding them straight underestimates the value — that is why the maths divides instead of multiplying.

servico.pergunta: Can I use it for a service?
servico.resposta: Yes. Instead of the product cost, enter your hourly cost multiplied by the hours of the service.
